checks.title: Application launches and exits cleanly
checks.instructions: Launch the exact commit candidate from a clean user session, confirm one visible app instance, then quit through the product UI without a crash or orphaned process.

checks.title: Settings opens from tray or menu bar
checks.instructions: Open Settings from the native tray or menu-bar item, verify the window can be reopened after closing, and confirm no duplicate background application is created.

checks.title: Settings persist across restart
checks.instructions: Change non-sensitive settings, restart the application, and confirm the selected mode, speed, jitter, notification, and shortcut values are restored.

checks.title: Trigger shortcut is replaced live
checks.instructions: Record a valid replacement Trigger shortcut, save it, verify the old shortcut no longer triggers, and verify the new shortcut triggers without restarting.

checks.title: Cancel shortcut is replaced live
checks.instructions: Record a valid replacement Cancel shortcut, save it, and verify cancellation uses the replacement shortcut immediately without restarting.

checks.title: Shortcut conflict rolls back both shortcuts
checks.instructions: Attempt to apply a shortcut known to be occupied, confirm the UI reports a conflict, and verify both previously active shortcuts remain registered and functional.

checks.title: Unsafe or ambiguous shortcut chords are rejected
checks.instructions: Verify bare letters, bare digits, Shift-only chords, and identical Trigger and Cancel shortcuts are rejected before system registration.

checks.title: Unicode, CJK, emoji, newline, and tab are delivered
checks.instructions: Use a disposable local test document and verify representative ASCII, CJK, emoji, line-break, and tab atoms are delivered in order; record only a content-blind pass reference.

checks.title: Cancellation stops delivery promptly
checks.instructions: Start a long disposable sample, invoke Cancel, and verify delivery stops within the documented latency budget without emitting a delayed tail after cancellation.

checks.title: Target change aborts safely
checks.instructions: Begin delivery in a disposable target, switch focus to a different application, and verify ClipType stops rather than continuing into the new target.

checks.title: Clipboard content and revision are preserved
checks.instructions: Exercise Keyboard, Clipboard, and Auto modes and verify the source clipboard remains unchanged after success, cancellation, and a guarded revision-change failure.

checks.title: Diagnostics contain no clipboard or typed content
checks.instructions: Inspect product diagnostics and gate evidence references for the run and confirm no clipboard content, typed sample, credential, or full log body is retained.

checks.title: Windows package installs, runs, and uninstalls
checks.instructions: Install the candidate through the supported package, launch it as a standard user, then uninstall it and confirm the installed executable and startup entry are removed.

checks.title: Windows startup setting is reversible
checks.instructions: Enable startup, sign out and back in to confirm launch, then disable startup and confirm the application no longer starts automatically.

checks.title: Windows build does not install a low-level keyboard hook
checks.instructions: Use an approved local inspection tool or debugger to confirm shortcut handling uses registered hotkeys and does not install a global low-level keyboard hook.

checks.title: Windows integrity boundary fails closed
checks.instructions: From a standard-user ClipType process, target an elevated application and confirm delivery is rejected or reported unavailable rather than silently partially injected.

checks.title: macOS menu-bar lifecycle is correct
checks.instructions: Verify the template icon, enabled state, mode selection, Settings action, permission status, startup toggle, and Quit action update correctly without a Dock-only lifecycle.

checks.title: macOS Accessibility prompt and grant flow works
checks.instructions: Start from an ungranted state, request Accessibility through ClipType, grant it in System Settings, return to ClipType, and verify the state becomes granted without reinstalling.

checks.title: macOS Accessibility revocation is detected
checks.instructions: After a granted run, revoke Accessibility in System Settings and verify ClipType reports revoked or unavailable and stops native delivery safely.

checks.title: macOS Secure Event Input blocks delivery safely
checks.instructions: Use an approved local Secure Event Input test target and verify ClipType reports unavailable or blocked without attempting a hidden fallback.

checks.title: macOS focused-target evidence prevents cross-target delivery
checks.instructions: Exercise same-window focus changes and application switches and verify focused-control or top-level target evidence produces the documented safe comparison result.

checks.title: macOS login-item setting is reversible
checks.instructions: Enable the SMAppService login item, sign out and back in to confirm launch, then disable it and confirm the application no longer starts automatically.

checks.title: Universal 2 candidate launches natively on Apple Silicon
checks.instructions: Confirm the Universal 2 candidate launches as arm64 on Apple Silicon and completes the core menu-bar, Settings, shortcut, and delivery checks without Rosetta.

checks.title: Universal 2 candidate launches as x86_64
checks.instructions: Confirm the Universal 2 candidate launches as x86_64 on Intel macOS or under the explicitly approved Rosetta test path and completes the core checks.

checks.title: macOS application bundle structure is complete
checks.instructions: Verify Info.plist, executable, resources, icon, supported architectures, minimum OS, bundle identifier, and executable permissions in the exact release candidate.

checks.title: Hardened Runtime and entitlements are correct
checks.instructions: Inspect the final signature and entitlements and confirm Hardened Runtime is enabled with no unexpected debugging, JIT, library-validation, or broad filesystem exceptions.

checks.title: Developer ID signature verifies deeply and strictly
checks.instructions: Run codesign deep strict verification and record only the command result, signing identity fingerprint reference, and artifact digest; never record credentials.

checks.title: Apple notarization is accepted
checks.instructions: Submit the signed candidate with notarytool, require an Accepted result, and reference the submission identifier without embedding the notarization credential or full log.

checks.title: Notarization ticket is stapled and validates
checks.instructions: Staple the accepted notarization ticket to the app or distribution image and require stapler validation to succeed on the final artifact.

checks.title: Gatekeeper accepts the final candidate
checks.instructions: Run spctl assessment against the final offline candidate and confirm Gatekeeper identifies an accepted notarized Developer ID application.

checks.title: Release artifact hashes are recorded
checks.instructions: Record SHA-256 references for the final app archive and DMG produced from the exact commit after signing, notarization, and stapling.
